concurrency.label: Concurrency
concurrency.coalesceIfActive: If a run is already active, keep just one follow-up run queued.

catchUp.label: Catch-up
catchUp.skipMissed: Ignore windows that were missed while the scheduler or routine was paused.
catchUp.enqueueMissedWithCap: Catch up missed schedule windows after recovery; sub-hourly schedules are combined into one catch-up run, slower schedules replay each missed window up to a cap.
